title: A declared name is one edit away from `cloud_firestore`
description: pubspec.yaml declares a declared package name in pubspec.yaml within one edit of `cloud_firestore`. The Dart toolchain resolves these names against pub.dev, so a name that only looks like the intended package brings foreign code into the app. The name this rule expects is `cloud_firestore`.
remediation: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `cloud_firestore`, correct it to that exact spelling.
limitation: It compares declared names with `cloud_firestore` by Levenshtein distance of one and reports a name that is not `cloud_firestore` itself; it cannot tell whether the similarly spelled package exists, who publishes it, whether it is malicious, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
